title: Kummer Stratum Chart
statement: For the exact published full parameter-root deck group, a simultaneous stratum chart consists of one root geometry with compatible characters, the boundary map killing every root, one finite continuous E-representation with finite prime-to-ell image, its two all-continuous coefficient models, both normalized global derived comparisons, their actual invariant scalar arrow and coefficient square, and their exact refinement formulas. For empty I the tower is invertible and the E-module has an actual pro-etale pullback trivialization; the same coefficient model supplies Omega. Built from [def-sfb-kummer-global-chart], [def-sfb-kummer-scalar-invariant-square], [def-sfb-kummer-chart-geometry-maps], [def-sfb-kummer-refinement], [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull].
